about: PRAY FOR REPENTANCE AND BE REBORN
The Binding of Isaac: Repentance is the ultimate edition of the award-winning roguelike twin-stick shooter.

It includes all the content from previous editions of The Binding of Isaac (Rebirth, Afterbirth and Afterbirth+) plus Repentance, the game's final and biggest-ever expansion, adding hundreds of additional new features, modes, and improvements.
Experience the modern classic like it's never been seen before!
THE GAME THAT DEFINED A GENRE
When Isaac’s mother starts hearing the voice of God, demanding a sacrifice be made to prove her faith, Isaac escapes into the dark and dangerous basement.
